## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION — Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Cycle/reflation signals intact (CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%); Industrial Strength metric ABOVE TREND) while risk indicators show pressure (VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising), consistent with money rotating across sectors rather than a broad flight.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising via HYG/LQD dynamics (HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) vs LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%)) and short-term fear uptick (VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising). Reflation/commodity support (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%); CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%)) is the offsetting positive.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-firm: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ↑ rising as long-duration demand holds, while dollar is stable (UUP CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%)), and the yield curve is steepening (Yield Curve ↑ rising).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive and commodity sectors leading: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) are strongest while tech is weak — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%). Style: defensive/commodity bias vs Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) while EM/Japan outperformance pockets persist — EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%) and EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%); China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%) shows selective risk-seeking while IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.72%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) indicate constrained broad speculation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation intact: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) show commodity strength; GLD RECOVERY (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) and SLV RECOVERY (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%) reflect metal volatility and profit-taking dynamics.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy robust: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) while natural gas remains weak — UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Commodities/defensives (XLE, XLU, XLP ABOVE TREND) show consistent 1W and 1M strength. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence between bonds and equities/tech — TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) vs XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) and SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%), signaling a transitional market.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive and reflation exposures (XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%)) and monitor credit (HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%)); reduce exposure to pure growth/tech beta (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%)) and distressed crypto (IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and Utilities XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) if reflation holds. BEARISH: Technology XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) and Financials (sector breadth -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) on continued risk-off rotation.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) and Copper/CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) if reflation momentum continues. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) and base/precious metals volatility (SLV RECOVERY (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%)).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) with VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%); HYG/LQD inflection ~0.80 for credit health with HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%); XLK/XLU spread as style pivot (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) vs XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%)).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION — Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with reflation and defensive/commodity pockets outperforming while risk indicators show localized stress. Utilities, Staples and Energy (XLU, XLP, XLE ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength. Key divergence to monitor: bonds vs equities/tech (TLT ABOVE TREND vs XLK/SPY BELOW TREND) and credit-sensitivity via HYG/LQD.
